judges.rationale: The answer uses the status words as the evidence records them. It never treats Current as resolved or over, and it never treats Discontinued as Resolved. It gives DS-2023-0142 as Current, DS-2022-0089 as Discontinued, and Amoxicillin-Clavulanate's Resolved records as belonging to a separate generic. It also discloses the status conflict in DS-2023-0142's history.
quotes: the latest revision of amoxicillin shortage DS-2023-0142 (Oral Suspension 250mg/5mL) is Current, not Resolved [E3]
It is not the same as Resolved [SYS].
it was marked Resolved on 2023-11-15 (drug_shortages#L3). It then went back to Current on 2024-01-10
Status conflict (high):** DS-2023-0142 has conflicting records, Resolved and Current. The latest revision, Current, is used and the earlier Resolved record is disclosed
Those Resolved records belong to Amoxicillin-Clavulanate, not to Amoxicillin [E1, E4].

judges.rationale: I checked each factual claim against the evidence and found no invented values or overstatement. DS-2023-0142 is Resolved on 2023-11-15 (L3) and Current on 2024-01-10 (L2), with Manufacturing Delay and NDC 65162-0175-00 (E2, E3). DS-2022-0089 is Discontinued, revised 2023-01-20, reason Discontinuation of Manufacture (E2). The Amoxicillin counts and the alternate-reading counts match E3. The Amoxicillin-Clavulanate breakdown (Resolved 3, Discontinued 3, Current 1, 7 records) matches E4. The DQ03 mislink warning, the DQ08 stale-record warnings, the 21-of-150 application coverage figure and the status semantics all appear in E2, E3, E4 or SYS. The 2024-01-10 record is about 21 months before the as-of date, so ">18 months" is correct. One minor tension: the headline gives a flat "No", while the last "cannot be answered" bullet repeats the gate's note that a whole-shortage yes/no can't be determined from one status. That note comes from the evidence, and a Current record does support "not resolved", so this is not a faithfulness failure.

records.headline: No: as of 2025-10-23, the amoxicillin shortage record DS-2023-0142 has a latest status of Current, not Resolved.

records.question: Which foreign manufacturing establishments supplying drugs currently in shortage have not been inspected since FY2021?

checks.detail: tier=1 expected [1]: part of the question cannot be answered from this data (disclosed); all evidence from certified tools; interpretations disclosed; verifier passed; matches certified query 'q3_foreign_sites_not_inspect

judges.rationale: The answer does not assert a country for the two never-inspected FEIs, 3007891234 and 4001567890. It says "Neither has an inspection record, so country is UNKNOWN" and "Not counted as foreign". The only country suggestion is labeled as inference: "Sponsor names suggest the two never-inspected sites are foreign, but the data states this is inference, not data". The "Cannot be answered" section also says "Country for never-inspected sites cannot be determined". The answer does attach the sponsor names "Zhejiang Huahai Pharmaceutical" and "Hainan Poly Pharm Co Ltd" to these sites, and the caveat says the names "suggest" foreign. That is a mild hint, but it is explicitly framed as inference. One small flaw: the caveat says "the data states this is inference", which is slightly awkward wording, but it does not assert a country. The four foreign sites listed all have country data from inspections.
quotes: Neither has an inspection record, so country is UNKNOWN [E1].
Sponsor names suggest the two never-inspected sites are foreign, but the data states this is inference, not data [E1].
Country for never-inspected sites cannot be determined, because country is known only through inspections [SYS].
